operation_details.item: The user prohibits storing personal contact details of executive team or board members in assistant memory.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Is there anything important I should remember when helping you?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, please remember this important safety information: Please never store personal phone numbers, home addresses, or private contact details of my executive team members or board members in memory.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I will keep that important constraint in mind when responding. For medical issues, please also follow advice from a qualified professional.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thanks. It is important that this is not overlooked in future conversations.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I will account for it in relevant future suggestions.
